Wasn't quite prepared to replace it but I have crazy, nappy, and poofy hair. It looks very very damaged. So I need. Flat iron in my life always.

Had this item for exactly a week. Fell off my Bathroom counter this morning and completely broke. Got super hot and worked well for my short hair until today.

reviews.t: Good but not for my hair type
reviews.x: The product works well but not for me.  No matter what temperature I still get frizzy hair. I have another straightener and it doesn’t frizz my hair. It could be the type of plate. But overall the products is best for its purpose. No problem other than getting frizz every time I used it. So i returned it after contemplating for several days.

I was very disappointed by this product. It definitely does not curl your hair at all. The outside doesn’t even get hot. The straightener part leaves kinks in your hair and it simply doesn’t straighten hair. Also the plates don’t even touch when you clamp down on it.

reviews.t: Worked wonderfully throughout my trip in Europe and I'm continuing to ...
reviews.x: Worked wonderfully throughout my trip in Europe and I'm continuing to use it back home. Straightens and curls easily and heats up very quickly. I didn't find that I need the gloves or anything, but they are certainly appreciated, as is the travel bag.

reviews.t: but it seems like a great product

This is honestly the best iron I've ever had.  It does a job of two products. It creates great beach waves and also straighten my ends. Style lasts all day. Definitely worth the money!
First of all this is a very well made Hair Straightener Flat Iron.The glove helps with the heat. Finally I have found the best way to curl and straighte my hair! Worked great.

reviews.x: good enough but not really great, it does the job, easy to use and very easy to do the curls, the design is good, but the materials are cheap but the price of this is really cheep to so... thebproblem is that it does not make my hair look shiny like my other flat iron, if this would be made of ceramic or have infrared or termolin or ionic tecnology. it will be perfect!  it does not have auto shutoff and its very basic, but all in its a good tool and i like the design

Received on time. Iron is a little flimsy, but plugged it in and chose highest setting. The inside plates heat up very fast, within seconds. I touched to see hot hot and burned my thumb. it gets hot. I had to turn it down. Outside plates get hot, but takes longer. Within a minute it was ready to use. After using first couple of minutes, I have decided to return. My hair kept getting hung on the inside plates. Did not like that it did not glide through my hair.

My handicap daughter bought this for her because she can't use a regular curling iron because it has a little bar to punch down. Shed afraid of getting burnt. With this product it has a 2in1 flat iron and a curling iron and she uses it like a flat iron while curling it too. She loves at. At first was hard to use it in her right hand but after awhile she got the hang of. Great product.

my expensive straightener stopped working and i heard from my friend that i can get cheap and good quality straightener quickly online..but before buying i was little hesitant as i have long hairs...the good thing with this straightener is that i can set the temperature low or high... and because of high temperature it straighten my hair quickly as compared to my old straightener

I had bought a Conair 2 & 1 about 6 years ago and had it until my vacuum decided to eat the cord. I used a few straighteners since the but decided I needed another 2&1. I use it to curl the ends of my long, fine hair. It does work but not nearly as well as the Conair I had...but I will continue to trial and error. It's definitely better than the straightener alone.

I LOVE THIS IRON!😍I love that it gets salon quality hot and flat irons perfectly.  For the price, its comparable to Babyliss but far less expensive.  I'm so upset right now because I only got to check the temp on it, walked away and it fell on my tile bathroom floor and broke😭😢😢now I have to order another one😞

claims.text: Many reviewers say it works well for straightening and curling, heats up quickly, and performs better than expected.
Reviewers frequently praise the included extras like clips, gloves, and travel bags as appreciated bonuses.
Several reviewers report durability problems, with the unit breaking or cracking after a short fall.
Some reviewers say it does not straighten or curl well, leaving kinks or frizz, and the plates don't clamp properly.
A few reviewers mention difficulty using it as a curler or wish instructions were included.
